description: This file defines the EventRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository for managing Event entities in a Spring Data JPA context. It includes a custom method findOverlapping to query events overlapping with a specified time range.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing Event entities with a custom method for finding overlapping events.

methods.name: findOverlapping
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events that overlap with the specified time window.

calls: SELECT e FROM Event e WHERE NOT (e.endTime < :from OR e.startTime > :to) ORDER BY e.startTime ASC
